function gpos(l, b, dLy): [number, number, number]

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/catalog/geo.ts:24

Galactic-coordinate placement — every deep-sky body lands on its real galactic (l, b) direction at the multi-tier compressed distance, in the same tilted frame the Milky Way particle disc and the deep-field cloud render. Directions stay astronomically true; only radii compress.

Parameters

l

number

Galactic longitude in degrees.

b

number

Galactic latitude in degrees.

dLy

number

Heliocentric distance in light-years.

Returns

[number, number, number]

[x, y, z] chart position in scene units.
